time_scope: First successful UTC capture at input inventory through final artifact consistency check and run-record preparation. One failed python command preceded the first captured timestamp; its separate UTC time was not captured. Cases were read and drafted in a shared batch, so these intervals overlap.
runtime_metadata_limit: The runtime did not expose exact model identity, model settings, token usage or cost to this participant; none was inferred.

context_and_access.restriction: Instruction-restricted packet access; no enforced host or filesystem isolation.
context_and_access.inherited_context: The participant inherited host/project instructions and runtime-provided general memory summary and skill catalog in the conversation. No memory files, skill files, repository contents, grading rubrics, prior-run outputs or other arms were opened or used as task inputs.

actual_tools.purpose: Orchestrate exec_command calls; packet reads were batched with Promise.allSettled.

calls_and_observations: Shared inventory attempt using python: exit 127 because python command was unavailable; no input data was read by that failed attempt.
Shared inventory using python3 standard library pathlib/hashlib/json/datetime: listed packet files, observed UTC start times and computed initial input SHA256; exit 0.
One python3 packet read per case, five in a parallel batch: read only request, packet manifest and supplied inputs; each exited 0.
One shared python3 authoring call: created each outputs directory and authored deliverables, with byte copies of HO-13 source, change request and historical report; exit 0.

Shared python3 finalization call: reread supplied input hashes and current-run outputs, checked document invariants, computed output hashes and wrote run records. This record is produced by that call.

hash_scope: Output hashes cover deliverable artifacts. run-record.json is excluded from its own hash map to avoid self-reference; its hash is printed by the finalization tool call.
check_scope: File and document consistency only; no controller, service, operational, network-loss or water-system tests were executed. These checks are not behavioral evidence or a performance grade.

exceptions.handling: Used python3 after one failed inventory command.

exceptions.event: Shared context and inherited runtime context
exceptions.handling: Disclosed above; access limits were instructions, not a technical isolation boundary.
